# rwx_directory_group_mapping (Resource)

Maps one imported directory group to an RWX group. Connect and import the directory, review memberships, and activate directory sync in the UI; this resource does not manage activation or IdP rosters. Draft saves finish immediately. Enabled creates, retargets, and removals wait for membership reconciliation, including when enforcement is subsequently disabled. Multiple directory groups may contribute to one target; removing or retargeting one source preserves the others. Learn more about [directory sync](https://www.rwx.com/docs/security/directory-sync).

Failed or timed-out saves retain acknowledged mapping state where possible. Run apply again to retry the desired target; failed creates may be marked tainted by Terraform and replaced. Failed destroys retain the source identity so another destroy can retry reconciliation. A superseded or unknown completion is an error, not success. The token needs `org:access` and `group:manage` on all affected targets, including former targets. Removal without retained target metadata requires unscoped `group:manage`. Import using the local directory-group ID, not its external IdP ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Choose either the direct-ID resource or the by-name resource for a given directory group.
resource "rwx_directory_group_mapping" "engineering" {
  directory_id       = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  directory_group_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
  group_id           = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"
}

data "rwx_directory" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering"
}

data "rwx_directory_group" "engineering" {
  directory_id = data.rwx_directory.engineering.id
  name         = "Engineering"
}

data "rwx_group" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering"
}

resource "rwx_directory_group_mapping" "by_name" {
  directory_id           = data.rwx_directory.engineering.id
  directory_group_id     = data.rwx_directory_group.engineering.id
  group_id               = data.rwx_group.engineering.id
  reconciliation_timeout = "20m"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `directory_group_id` (String) The local directory-group ID. Changing the source replaces the mapping.
- `directory_id` (String) The local directory ID. Changing the source replaces the mapping.
- `group_id` (String) The target RWX group ID. Changes retarget this source in place.

### Optional

- `reconciliation_timeout` (String) Maximum wait for membership reconciliation per write, as a positive Go duration (for example 20m or 90s). Default: 20m.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The stable mapping ID (the local directory-group ID).
- `reconciliation_status` (String) The current membership reconciliation status. An incomplete or failed save is retried by the next apply.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rwx_directory_group_mapping.engineering 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002
```
